description:
Manually add a cookie to a site's inventory (for cookies the scanner cannot auto-detect).

Args:
  - id (string): The site id.
  - name (string): Cookie name, e.g. "_ga".
  - purpose (string): What the cookie does.
  - categoryId (string): A real cookie-category id belonging to THIS site. Call consentease_list_categories first and use an id from its data array. The compliance report contains counts, not category IDs. A categoryId from another site is rejected.
  - provider (string, optional): e.g. "Google Analytics".
  - expiry (string, optional): e.g. "2 years", "Session".
  - type ("first-party" | "third-party", optional): Defaults to "first-party".

Returns JSON: the created Cookie object. Returns bad_request if categoryId is missing or does not belong to this site. Retry-safe by site and trimmed cookie name (case-sensitive): an existing name returns conflict (HTTP 409) with the existing cookie id in the hint, without adding a row. On an uncertain response, retry the same name and use the returned existing id; do not invent another name. Requires scope: sites:write.

categoryId.description: A cookie-category id that belongs to THIS site.

id.description: The ConsentEase site id (UUID) the cookie belongs to.

purpose.description: What the cookie is used for.

name: consentease_add_cookie
title: Add a cookie to a site
